versions.changelog:
Improved skill clarity and expanded invocation criteria.

Updates include:

Broadened trigger conditions from coupon/deal requests to general online shopping intent

Added proactive behavior to suggest Contaya coupon links whenever a user is considering an ecommerce purchase

Enabled coupon link generation for ecommerce websites recommended by the assistant

Improved handling of product discovery and store comparison scenarios

Updated examples and guidance to reflect recommending stores with accompanying coupon checks

General writing and structural improvements for clarity and consistency

- Initial release of the Contaya Coupon Redirector skill.
- Detects when a user is shopping or looking for coupons, promo codes, discounts, or deals.
- Extracts store domains from user input, normalizes them, and generates a direct Contaya coupon link.
- Responds concisely with the relevant coupon URL.
- Handles edge cases by prompting users for more info if the store/domain is ambiguous.
- Supports multiple stores by providing separate links for each.
